newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus president's daughter to marry peace activist.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus president's daughter to marry peace activist.

text.p: Cypriot President Glafcos Clerides's daughter Katy on Tuesday announced her engagement to Greek Cypriot businessman Costas Shammas.
Katy Clerides, 47, an MP for the right-wing Democratic Rally party which her father founded in 1976, is due to marry Shammas in the spring.
Both are active members of a privately-run peace council aimed at rapprochement with Turkish Cypriots on the divided island.
Last month she denied Greek newspaper reports she was having an affair with a Turkish Cypriot lecturer at the University of Cyprus.
